name: PT1000 RTD
description: The PT1000 is a platinum RTD with a nominal resistance of 1000Ω at 0°C. Its higher base resistance compared to the PT100 means that the resistance change per degree is larger in absolute terms, allowing it to be used directly with a standard 3D printer control board's thermistor input (typically with a 4.7kΩ pullup resistor) without a dedicated amplifier. This makes it a popular upgrade over NTC thermistors for users seeking better accuracy without additional hardware. Klipper supports it natively with the 'PT1000' sensor type.
